content: ADAM-MILI NYIRRIRNIKARTIJARRANGU (5:1-32)
Nyungu muwarr yarntarnayi purlpija, Adam-milaku partanykarrangupa karlujipa jamujirrangupa nyirrirnikartijarranguku.
Ngarrkalu marrngurrangu yarni manajalu, palinykapali yarni marnajaninyi. Pirirripa mirtawa yarni marnajaninyi, ngalypa jirnijanaku, ngalypa wurrarnajanaku, yini marnayi “marrngu”.
Adam 130 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku. Palinymili partany palinyngarrakapali. Yini marna palinymili partany “Seth”.
Seth ngayarta jarrinyaja, Adam wanka jarrinyikinyi 800 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyapulujaninyi Adam-jupa Eve-ju.
Adam wanka jarrinyi 930 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Seth 105 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Enosh.
Enosh ngayarta jarrinyaja, Seth wanka jarrinyikinyi 807 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Seth wanka jarrinyi 912 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Enosh 90 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Kenan.
Kenan ngayarta jarrinyaja, Enosh wanka jarrinyikinyi 815 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Enosh wanka jarrinyi 905 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Kenan 70 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Mahalalel.
Mahalalel ngayarta jarrinyaja, Kenan wanka jarrinyikinyi 840 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Kenan wanka jarrinyi 910 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Mahalalel 65 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Jared.
Jared ngayarta jarrinyaja, Mahalalel wanka jarrinyikinyi 830 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Mahalalel wanka jarrinyi 895 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Jared 162 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Enoch.
Enoch ngayarta jarrinyaja, Jared wanka jarrinyikinyi 800 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Jared wanka jarrinyi 962 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Enoch 65 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Methuselah.

Methuselah ngayarta jarrinyaja, Enoch marnti jarrikinyapulu Ngarrka, wirrirni Ngarrka ngarlungu yija ['lived in close fellowship with God']. Wanka jarrinyikinyi 300 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Enoch wanka jarrinyi 365 partunurrangu,
marnti jarrinyapulu Ngarrka, [walking in close fellowship with God], palaja karrpu warinyja partarl parrjarnamayi, palanga munu wanima, kanya Ngarrkalu.
Methuselah 187 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku, Lamech.
Lamech ngayarta jarrinyaja, Methuselah wanka jarrinyikinyi 782 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Methuselah wanka jarrinyi 969 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Lamech 182 partunurrangujartiny jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyi partany pirirriku.
Lamech-ju partany yini marna Noah, wurrarna, . . . . . . . . [“May he bring us relief from our work and the painful labour of farming this ground that the Lord has cursed.”]
Noah ngayarta jarrinyaja, Lamech wanka jarrinyikinyi 595 partunurrangu, partanykarrangu pirirripa mirtawa kanyajaninyi.
Lamech wanka jarrinyi 777 partunurrangu, palaja marlkarri jarrinyi.
Noah 500 partunurrangu jarrinyaja, japartu jarrinyijanaku Shem-pa Ham-pa Japheth.
